theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 55 群

items.pos: adv. 敏銳地 | 強烈地
items.colloc: keenly aware 強烈意識到 | keenly interested 很有興趣
items.distinct: sharply 尖銳地 | acutely 劇烈地
ex: Management is keenly aware of the market changes.
管理層敏銳地意識到市場變化。
Employees are keenly interested in the new policy.
員工對新政策非常有興趣。
He listened keenly to the consultant's advice.
他專注且敏銳地聽取顧問建議。

items.pos: n. 實驗室
items.colloc: research laboratory 研究實驗室 | in the laboratory 在實驗室裡
items.distinct: lab 實驗室（口語縮寫）| facility 設施
ex: Our laboratory focuses on innovative product development.
我們的實驗室專注於創新產品研發。
Samples were sent to the laboratory for analysis.
樣本已被送往實驗室進行分析。
Strict safety protocols are required in the laboratory.
實驗室內必須遵守嚴格的安全規範。

items.pos: n. 著陸 | 登陸 | 樓梯平台
items.colloc: safe landing 安全著陸 | landing gear 起落架
items.distinct: arrival 到達 | docking 停靠
ex: The flight made a smooth landing in Taipei.
該航班順利在台北著陸。
Landing the contract was a huge achievement.
拿下這份合約是一項巨大成就。
Check the landing page for promotion details.
查看到達頁面以獲取促銷詳情。

items.pos: n. 景觀設計 | 造景
items.colloc: landscaping project 造景工程 | exterior landscaping 戶外造景
items.distinct: gardening 園藝 | architecture 建築設計
ex: The company hired experts for office landscaping.
公司聘請專家進行辦公室景觀設計。
Improved landscaping enhances the building's aesthetic value.
改善景觀設計能提升建築美學價值。
Budget constraints delayed the landscaping work.
預算限制延誤了造景工程。

items.pos: n. 車道 | 小徑 | 航道
items.colloc: fast lane 快車道 | bus lane 公車專用道
items.distinct: road 道路 | path 小徑
ex: Please stay in the designated bus lane.
請保持在指定的公車專用道上。
Trucks must remain in the right lane.
卡車必須保持在右側車道行駛。
The delivery van changed lanes abruptly.
貨車突然變換了車道。

items.pos: n. 裝載 | 負載
items.colloc: loading dock 裝卸貨碼頭 | loading capacity 載重量
items.distinct: shipping 運輸 | packing 包裝
ex: The loading process will take two hours.
裝載過程將需要兩個小時。
Trucks are waiting at the loading dock.
卡車正在裝卸碼頭等待。
Check the maximum loading capacity before storage.
存放前請檢查最大負載量。

items.pos: adv. 當地地 | 局部地
items.colloc: locally sourced 當地採購 | locally produced 當地生產
items.distinct: regionally 區域性地 | domestically 國內地
ex: We prefer using locally sourced organic ingredients.
我們偏好使用當地採購的有機食材。
The company is locally operated and managed.
該公司是由當地營運與管理的。
This item is produced locally by small firms.
此產品由小型廠商在當地製造。

items.pos: adv. 寬鬆地 | 不精確地
items.colloc: loosely based 鬆散地基於 | loosely connected 鬆散聯繫
items.distinct: tightly 緊密地 | freely 自由地
ex: The agreement is loosely based on previous terms.
該協議鬆散地基於先前的條款。
These two departments are only loosely connected.
這兩個部門的聯繫並不緊密。
The requirements were defined rather loosely.
需求定義得相當模糊不精確。

items.pos: n. 行軍 | 進展 | v. 前進
items.colloc: a long march 長途跋涉 | steady march 穩步前進
items.distinct: advance 進展 | walk 步行
ex: Technology continues its steady march forward.
科技持續穩步地向前邁進。
The protest march disrupted city traffic.
示威遊行導致市區交通中斷。
Our team marched toward the final deadline.
我們的團隊向最後期限推進。

items.pos: adv. 同時 | 在此期間
items.colloc: in the meanwhile 在此期間 | meanwhile, back at the office 同時在辦公室
items.distinct: at the same time 同時 | during which 在此期間
ex: Please wait; meanwhile, enjoy some coffee.
請稍候；在此期間，請享用咖啡。
The manager is away; meanwhile, I handle calls.
經理不在；在此期間由我處理電話。
The report is pending; meanwhile, prepare data.
報告尚在審核；同時先準備數據。

items.pos: n. 採礦業 | 礦業
items.colloc: mining company 礦業公司 | data mining 數據探勘
items.distinct: drilling 鑽探 | extraction 萃取
ex: The mining industry faces strict safety regulations.
礦業面臨嚴格的安全法規。
Global mining firms met to discuss output.
全球礦業公司開會討論產量。
She specializes in advanced data mining techniques.
她專精於先進的數據探勘技術。

items.pos: v. 服從 | 遵守
items.colloc: obey rules 遵守規則 | obey orders 服從命令
items.distinct: comply 遵守（規定）| follow 跟隨
ex: All staff must obey the safety regulations.
所有員工必須遵守安全規則。
He refused to obey the supervisor's direct order.
他拒絕服從主管的直接命令。
Employees are expected to obey company policies.
員工被要求必須遵守公司政策。

items.pos: adj. 明顯的 | 顯而易見的
items.colloc: obvious choice 明顯的選擇 | obvious mistake 明顯的錯誤
items.distinct: evident 明顯的 | apparent 表面上的
ex: The decline in sales is quite obvious.
銷售額的下滑相當明顯。
It was an obvious error in the calculation.
那是計算中一個顯而易見的錯誤。
There is no obvious reason for the delay.
延遲並沒有明顯的原因。

items.pos: v. 冒犯 | 觸怒
items.colloc: offend someone 冒犯某人 | unintentionally offend 無意中冒犯
items.distinct: insult 羞辱 | annoy 使煩惱
ex: I did not mean to offend the client.
我無意冒犯那位客戶。
Such language may offend some senior staff.
這種語言可能會冒犯部分資深員工。
He spoke carefully to avoid offending anyone.
他謹慎發言以避免冒犯任何人。

items.pos: adv. 公開地 | 直率地
items.colloc: openly discuss 公開討論 | openly admit 公開承認
items.distinct: publicly 公眾地 | frankly 坦率地
ex: The board members openly discussed the merger.
董事會成員公開討論了合併案。
They openly admit that mistakes were made.
他們公開承認犯了錯。
Issues should be addressed openly among teams.
問題應該在團隊間公開地解決。

items.pos: adj. 相反的 | 對立的
items.colloc: opposing view 對立觀點 | opposing side 對立面
items.distinct: contrary 相反的 | conflicting 衝突的
ex: The two candidates hold opposing political views.
兩位候選人持有對立的政治觀點。
Both sides presented opposing evidence in court.
雙方在法庭上提出了相反的證據。
She listened to the opposing opinion calmly.
她冷靜地傾聽了對立的意見。

items.pos: adj. 有條理的 | 整齊的 | v. 訂購；命令
items.colloc: well ordered 井然有序 | ordered list 有序列表
items.distinct: organized 有組織的 | systematic 系統性的
ex: The office files are kept in an ordered manner.
辦公室檔案保存得井然有序。
We have ordered new equipment for the lab.
我們已經為實驗室訂購了新設備。
The manager ordered the team to finish early.
經理命令團隊提早完成工作。

items.pos: adj. 普通的 | 平常的
items.colloc: ordinary day 平凡的一天 | ordinary citizen 普通市民
items.distinct: common 常見的 | regular 規律的
ex: This is no ordinary business transaction.
這不是一筆普通的商業交易。
It was just an ordinary meeting with staff.
那只是一場與員工的普通會議。
She prefers an ordinary desk to a standing one.
比起站立式辦公桌，她更偏好普通的桌子。

items.pos: n. 起源 | 來源 | 出身
items.colloc: country of origin 原產國 | origin of the problem 問題根源
items.distinct: source 來源 | cause 原因
ex: Please state the country of origin on the form.
請在表格上註明原產國。
We are researching the origin of this software bug.
我們正在調查這個軟體錯誤的源頭。
The new brand has its origin in Italy.
這個新品牌源自於義大利。

items.pos: n. 包裝 | 包裝業
items.colloc: packaging design 包裝設計 | eco-friendly packaging 環保包裝
items.distinct: wrapping 包裝紙 | container 容器
ex: Attractive packaging can increase product sales.
吸引人的包裝能提升產品銷量。
We need more eco-friendly packaging materials.
我們需要更多環保的包裝材料。
Check the packaging for damage upon arrival.
貨到時請檢查包裝是否有損壞。
